verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state budgets can be set to cap spend for a team, project, API key, or team member, directly matching the story, and spend monitoring/usage dashboards support enforcement. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that hard budgets actually block spend at the limit (community evidence only discusses BYOK balance blocking, not per-key/team/user budget enforcement specifics) and more detail on granularity/configuration UI.
